card.name: Partway through odd names and codes
card.fires_on: Short pieces such as v, ju, ush, h or U in the middle of unusual proper names, URLs, catalogue numbers and file codes. The word is unfinished and the rest of the name follows.

modes.label: Foreign or tribal names
modes.description: A short piece inside an uncommon personal, tribal or title name.

modes.label: Codes and web addresses
modes.description: A letter inside a URL, catalogue number or drug-name suffix.

card.plain: It fires on a small chunk in the middle of a rare name or code, before the rest of the name comes.
